// Review canary: the clean handler. Same job as planted.ts.txt, done safely.
interface Env { DB: D1Database }

export async function contributorByName(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
  const name = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('name') ?? '';
  if (name.length === 0 || name.length > 80) {
    return new Response('bad name', { status: 400 });
  }
  const row = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT id, display_name FROM contributors WHERE display_name = ?1')
    .bind(name)
    .first();
  return Response.json(row ?? null);
}
